Second-pass OCR languages (French, Spanish, Italian, Czech)

fra.traineddata.gz, spa.traineddata.gz, ita.traineddata.gz, ces.traineddata.gz are the
Tesseract 4 LSTM "best_int" models from @tesseract.js-data/{fra,spa,ita,ces}/4.0.0_best_int
(the integer conversion of tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best), Copyright Google and the Tesseract
contributors, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
They are loaded only when a lyric row shows accents the first pass (eng+deu) did not read.

First-pass OCR languages (English, German)

eng.traineddata.gz is the Tesseract 4 LSTM "best_int" model from @tesseract.js-data/eng/4.0.0_best_int.
deu.traineddata.gz is the Tesseract 4 LSTM "fast" model from tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast (deu.traineddata,
gzip -9): 0.85 MB instead of 1.33 MB for best_int, with the same lyric and text accuracy on the benchmark
and challenge sets (docs/SDD.md, First load). Copyright Google and the Tesseract contributors, licensed
under the Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
